svg.text: Containerised microservices on a managed Kubernetes cluster, with queue-driven workers that scale on backlog and a GitOps release flow.
Web and mobile clients → Domain: look up the app's address
Web and mobile clients → Web firewall: filter malicious traffic (HTTPS)
Web firewall → Cluster ingress: spread requests across healthy instances
Cluster ingress → API microservices: run the business logic
API microservices → Orders and catalogue: read and write records
API microservices → Sessions and hot catalogue: read and refresh cached results
API microservices → Product images: store or read files
API microservices → Order queue: queue the job (new order)
API microservices → Customer accounts: verify the user's sign-in token
API microservices → Service credentials: fetch credentials
Every component → Logs, metrics, traces: send logs and metrics
Generated by Clarchy. Service names belong to their owners; Clarchy is not affiliated with AWS.
